# QEMU Settings select provider parameters

Installs the two const.system.sharePicker parameters only after the complete
Settings/native chooser successor verifies. Unknown, duplicated, partial or
conflicting parameters fail without rewriting the product file. Other product
profile parameters and its mode are preserved. Repeated application verifies
all chooser targets and dependencies again. This configures the real private
Settings UIAbility; it does not validate signed provider installation or guest
caller/result/URI/permission behavior. Both phone and 2in1 require runtime proof.
